# Security policy

## Supported versions

The 1.4.x series receives security updates until 2031-03-01. Older series are
end of life and receive no fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Send reports to security@acme.invalid. We acknowledge within three working
days and aim to provide a remediation plan within ten working days.

Please include the affected version, the deployment shape (container, VM,
appliance) and a reproduction. Do not open a public issue for security
reports.

## Coordinated disclosure

We publish an advisory once a fix is available, and we credit reporters who
ask to be credited. We ask for a 90-day embargo, shortened by agreement when
a fix ships earlier.
